ranking_method: Provisional research component scoring; machine-learning forecasts not included
comparison: Top-five equal-weight shortlisted stocks vs all 33 equal-weight eligible ranked stocks
target: Next observed close entry through 20-session exit; local-currency, unadjusted close-price return

assumed_transaction_costs.note: Same assumed fixed round-trip cost is deducted from each arm; it cancels in the measured excess-return differential. Portfolio-specific turnover, spread, slippage, tax and FX costs are not modeled.

limitations: Historical model-development diagnostics, not untouched prospective tests or proof of investment skill.
Today's fixed active 33-stock list introduces survivorship and historical-universe selection bias.
Backfilled filings/news without evidence of pre-cutoff availability are excluded; this is not a verified original-filing-date source.
No stock split/dividend total-return consistency, currency conversions, transaction-level execution, liquidity, spread, slippage, taxes or portfolio turnover has been established.
A cross-market 20-session horizon can refer to different calendar dates on US and UK exchanges.
Twenty-session outcomes sampled every 30 calendar days may be dependent; no statistically valid performance-confidence interval is claimed.
Results are from an equal-weight top-five diagnostic, not the application's diversified whole-share portfolio allocation.
The report does not measure current investment suitability or the likelihood that today's top-ranked stock will appreciate.
